pdf.js 6.3.289 — Apache-2.0, Mozilla Foundation — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
The ESM builds from cdnjs (pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs), renamed to .js so every host serves
them as JavaScript. Loaded by deck.js (pitch.html) to draw the pitch deck slide by slide.
To upgrade: download the same two files from https://cdnjs.com/libraries/pdf.js and overwrite.
